title: Connectors
subtitle: Connect EVE to the services she may use for your work. Credentials stay protected and changes require your approval.

blocked.title: Connector Catalog unavailable
blocked.description: The local connector configuration is not available yet. Restart Command EVE or check the installation.
blocked.electronBridgeRequired: Local connectors can only be managed in the Command EVE desktop app.

errors.loadFailed: Connector Catalog could not be loaded.

actions.guidedSetupDisabled: EVE does not change a connection without a safety check and your approval.

preflight.successDescription: The check was stored locally. EVE can now use the verified status.
preflight.blockedDescription: EVE did not activate the connection. Review the next step shown here.

statusNote.view_receipt: Connected and preflight-proven. The receipt is stored locally — nothing to do here.
statusNote.request_humangate: Waiting for your approval. The connection is enabled only after that.
statusNote.inspect_blocker: The last preflight is blocked. The cause is in the preflight receipt / log.

secretHandling.never_in_chat: Stored securely and never shown in chat

empty.preflightMissing: Not checked yet. EVE does not treat this connection as active.

cardDescriptions.installed: This capability is available locally and ready for a safe check.
cardDescriptions.available: This capability can be set up when needed.
cardDescriptions.needs_auth: Protected credentials are still required for this connection.
cardDescriptions.unverified: This connection has not been checked yet.
cardDescriptions.gated: This capability requires your approval before activation.
cardDescriptions.connected: EVE can use this verified connection.
cardDescriptions.blocked: This connection remains disabled for safety.

security.summary: Credentials are never stored in chat or visible settings.
security.approval: EVE activates no connection without a successful check and any required approval.
security.minimumAccess: EVE receives only the access she needs. Sensitive changes remain blocked.
security.protectedActions: Direct changes to credentials, connections, and automations stay blocked without a safety check and approval.
